notes.title: August 14 2022 Update
notes.content: This update includes various minor bug fixes along with the addition of a chapter select allowing for players to restart any section of the game or move ahead if there are problems.

notes.title: Blackhaven - August 2nd Update
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Blackhaven!  The changes covered by the update are listed below.  Please enjoy, review, and let us know as new issues arise.  And thanks for your patience.  All art and coding on Blackhaven was done by one person, me!

BUG FIXES
-Bathroom doors can no longer be entered at any point, freezing the game
-Zooming in while viewing the family portrait sign in the gallery no longer freezes the game
-Two gallery quiz questions have been altered to be more fair and avoid ambiguity
-Typo on the Pillars sign in the main house fixed

CHANGES
-Audio normalized throughout the game and volume shifts between dialogue and musical cues are smoother

KNOWN ISSUES
-Still investigating various reported crashes.

Thanks again!
